recentItems.title: Turtles Meet a Lightning Thief!⚡️ | Teeny Mutant Ninja Turtles Ep. 10 "Lights Out" 😱 | Full Episode
recentItems.description:
A new ninja named Karai is stealing all of the city's power and causing a major blackout! Leo, Donnie, Raph, and Mikey will need to out-ninja her to get everyone's lights back on.

Everyone’s favorite ninja turtles, Leo, Raph, Donnie, and Mikey, are back! Set in their childhood years, this original series explores the early days of the iconic ninja turtles on their first adventures as ninjas-in-training. They’ll even be joined by their friend April O’Neil, and encounter foes like Bebop, Rocksteady, and Karai. Watch new episodes of Teeny Mutant Ninja Turtles right here on the Nick Jr. YouTube channel!
